title: Implement idempotency, inbox/outbox, and PostgreSQL jobs

features.title: Unit tests for in-memory repository implementations
Fix review issues in runtime repositories
Address v3 review issues (third review pass)

findings: TypeScript typechecks pass cleanly in both workflow and data packages
All 497 existing tests continue to pass
File writes required copy from /projects/sandbox to /root/counterX due to environment path mapping
45 new tests added across 4 test files, total test count now 542
The actual implementations at /root/counterX use a simpler API than what read_file shows (different filesystem layers)

Tests cover: idempotency acquire/replay/conflict/in-flight/re-acquire, outbox append/claim/dispatch/fail-backoff/deadLetter, inbox receive/dedup/markProcessed, jobs enqueue/claim/lease-takeover/renew/complete/fail/poison/deadLetter

FEAT-006: Fixed 3 review issues - expired-lease pre-claim sweep in PostgresJobRepository.claim, clock_timestamp() in PostgresIdempotencyStore.fail, undefined guard in PostgresIdempotencyStore.complete

FEAT-006 (second pass): Fixed 4 additional review issues from 2025-01-15-220300-review.md: (1) in-memory outbox claim now claims both pending and failed events past nextAttemptAt, (2) eventVersion changed from string to number in OutboxEvent/OutboxEventInput interfaces, (3) AsyncJobRepository.claim now accepts limit parameter (default 10) instead of hardcoded LIMIT 10, (4) PostgresOutboxRepository.markFailed now uses atomic UPDATE with SET attempts = attempts + 1 and SQL power() for backoff
FEAT-007: All 3 v3 review issues (in-memory complete lease fields, extra bind param, sync limit param) were already resolved in prior commits - no code changes needed
